summary: Diginex Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting an amended acquisition agreement to acquire all of Resulticks Global Companies Pte. Limited. The transaction value was reduced from US$1.5 billion to US$1.05 billion, payable entirely in equity via 600 million newly issued Diginex shares at US$1.75 per share. Completion is targeted by October 30, 2026. The filing also details a side agreement where the Pelham Parties terminate founder and IPO warrants, RSUs, and PSUs in exchange for 40 million shares subject to forfeiture if a specified additional investment is not received. The transaction includes lock-up and registration rights agreements. Watch for regulatory approvals and successful funding of the additional investment.
